title: Concept: eval applied to a decoded payload
description: An eval call wrapped around a decode function in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: Evaluating decoded content executes whatever the string contains, and the decode step exists only to hide the payload from readers and filters; this is the shape of a web shell or a malicious snippet.
applicability: Compromised pages, injected widgets and third-party scripts.
risk: The decoded payload runs with the page's full privileges, including session cookies and API calls.
